name: mitosis

phase_0.boundary_condition: The plasma membrane and cell cycle checkpoints that contain and regulate the division process

VINIT.justification: The void before DNA synthesis, the uninitialized cellular state awaiting the replication signal.

TANCH.justification: The closed boundary that contains the cytoplasm and defines the physical limits of the cell.

AFWD.justification: Directed forward morphism progressing the cell from prophase toward metaphase alignment.

AREV.justification: Reverse transformation dismantling the cell or returning it to quiescence upon checkpoint failure.

CLINK.justification: Sequential chaining of molecular events that drive the ordered phases of the cell cycle.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential blueprint that contains the instructions for its own replication and cellular identity.

FSPLIT.justification: Co-multiplication where the single genome branches into two identical sister chromatid sets.

FFUSE.justification: Multiplication where the two separated chromatid sets reconstitute the original cellular form as two independent daughter cells.

EVALT.justification: Affirmative evaluation where all kinetochores are correctly attached to the spindle.

EVALF.justification: Negative evaluation triggering the inhibitory signal to halt the cycle.

ENGAGR.justification: A paradice where sister kinetochores are pulled by equal and opposite forces, held in a state of tension without resolution until anaphase.

IFIX.justification: Permanent, append-only record of the replication cycle, marking cellular age and gene expression.

phase_2.split_input: The cellular lineage and genetic blueprint (parent cell)
split_outputs: Sister chromatid set A (destined for Daughter Cell 1)
Sister chromatid set B (destined for Daughter Cell 2)
phase_2.fuse_result: Two independent daughter cells, collectively reconstituting the original cellular lineage and genetic blueprint

phase_3.void_description: G0/G1 phase, the uninitialized state before DNA replication, lacking duplicated genetic material
phase_3.true_description: Metaphase alignment achieved, Spindle Assembly Checkpoint satisfied, cell cycle progresses to anaphase
phase_3.false_description: Checkpoint failure, unattached kinetochores, cell cycle arrest or apoptotic dismantling
phase_3.both_description: Metaphase tension, sister kinetochores held in equal and opposite poleward pull, a paradice of forces maintained without resolution

steps.domain_action: Genesis of the cell cycle in G1 phase, the uninitialized state before replication.
The genome acts as the self-referential blueprint, recognizing its own sequence for duplication.
Sequential chaining of Cyclin-CDK complexes, driving the ordered progression through cell cycle phases.
The plasma membrane forms the closed boundary containing the parent cell cytoplasm.
S-phase co-multiplication, the single genome branches into two identical sister chromatid sets.
Prophase and prometaphase progression, forward morphism of chromatin condensation and spindle capture.
Spindle Assembly Checkpoint satisfied, all kinetochores achieve correct bipolar attachment.
Metaphase tension, sister kinetochores held in equal and opposite poleward pull, a paradice of forces maintained without resolution.
Checkpoint unsatisfied, unattached kinetochores generate the wait-anaphase signal.
Descent into cell cycle arrest or apoptotic cascade, reversing the mitotic commitment.
Cytokinesis and abscission, the two chromatid sets reconstitute the original cellular lineage as two independent daughter cells.
Epigenetic methylation and telomere attrition, the permanent append-only record of the division cycle.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Cyclin-CDK kinase complexes and transcription factors that translate genetic intentions into phase-specific operations
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Chemical gradients, second messengers, and phosphorylation cascades communicating state across the cytoplasm
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Epigenetic methylation patterns, histone modifications, and the DNA sequence itself storing cellular state
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Spindle Assembly Checkpoint and ubiquitin-mediated proteolysis determining the timing of phase transitions
phase_5.alfs_store: The reference genome and the maternal cytoplasmic environment providing the bootstrap store for cellular identity

phase_6.cycle_cost: ATP hydrolysis for motor proteins, chromatin remodeling, and membrane scission
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A single parent cell in G2 phase with duplicated 4C DNA content and condensed chromosomes
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Two distinct daughter cells in G1 phase, each with 2C DNA content and restored cytoplasmic volume
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The Frobenius round-trip of replication and division conserves genetic information exactly; thermodynamic entropy increases locally but structural information entropy remains invariant across the lineage.
